entities.summary: Sagami-ji , is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Kasai, Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. Its mountain name (sangō) is Senjōsan (泉生山). Emperor Shōmu ordered its construction in 745 at the request of Gyōki, a Buddhist priest.
